text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training on a holiday... Watching 
Mejiro Ramonu get ready, I felt a little 
nervous.
choice_data_list:
(Today, I'm going to invite Ramonu to 
lunch!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A while has passed since we began 
practicing together, but I still haven't 
been able to have a deep conversation with 
her... or really, much of a conversation 
at all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crucial moments will surely arise many 
times from here on. I want to build as 
much trust as possible so I can be there 
to provide mental support when the time 
comes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then...
choice_data_list: Can I have a little more time?
Can I have a little more time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: How about a lunch meeting after this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, I shall call upon 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, since it wasn't needed 
right now, I was flatly turned down."
choice_data_list:
(Maybe it's best not to dwell on it after 
all.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, she has handled her 
training perfectly all on her own. She 
likely feels no need to build a bond with 
a Trainer. But...
choice_data_list: (I want to know more about Ramonu.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if they don't ask for it, as long as 
you know what kind of person they are, 
there are things we can prepare on our 
end."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I want to find a way to 
get a conversation going with her. To 
learn how to do that—I want to talk to 
someone who understands her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My name is Mejiro Ardan. I am the younger 
sister of... Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Mejiro Ardan. I might be able to hear 
something from her.
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I should pay the Mejiro family a 
visit)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So when I paid them a visit—as luck would 
have it, promising "Mejiro Umamusume" were 
all gathered together!
choice_data_list: You're Mejiro McQueen!
You are Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!
choice_data_list: You're Mejiro Palmer!
You are Mejiro Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yes, hello, Palmer-san speaking!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen, who was already renowned 
as a stayer before enrolling. And Mejiro 
Palmer, whose running was as breezy and 
lighthearted as her personality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...W-What is with this person—
choice_data_list: You're Mejiro Dober!
You are Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hello~.
choice_data_list: Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, who is rarely seen running 
in public, but shows glimpses of pure 
talent. Mejiro Bright, rumored to possess 
boundless stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san...
choice_data_list: Needless to say, Mejiro Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... you know all of us, even 
before our debut...?!"
choice_data_list: Of course, Mejiro Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan, delicate yet possessing a 
hidden resolve. And Mejiro Ryan, 
captivating everyone with her dynamic 
running...!
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to seeing what you all 
accomplish from here on out!

I'm looking forward to seeing what 
everyone accomplishes from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. So the rumors about loving racing 
were true...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your kind words. By the 
way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I haven't asked what brings you here. My 
sister isn't around at the moment, 
though...
choice_data_list: About that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see... A way to talk with Big Sis.
choice_data_list:
And maybe share some nostalgic stories 
while we're at it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I'm sure Ardan-san has plenty, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We probably don't know much more about Ms. 
Ramonu than you do, Trainer, don't you 
think?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: N-No, seriously!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When I think of Ms. Ramonu, she's like 
that super gorgeous older girl who 
occasionally shows up to gatherings...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! I still remember the day we 
first met...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When I was introduced to her, she was just 
so beautiful. I got so embarrassed I 
couldn't even say a word...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When I went quiet, Ramonu-san put an index 
finger to my lips.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "It's fine. Your eyes speak volumes..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait! You're making me blush like 
crazy~!"
choice_data_list: So you've always been like that.
So you've always been like that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. She has always been someone 
the entire Mejiro family looks up to.
choice_data_list: Admiration...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when imitating Ramonu-san 
was quite the trend among the Mejiro 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She always walks with her chest out and 
head held high, never losing her 
composure...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but for a period of time, it felt 
as though her demeanor had changed 
slightly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah! I remember that too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it, there were times 
when... Ramonu-san seemed a bit on edge, 
you know?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps it's about the time when I 
couldn't run."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There was a time during my sister's 
childhood when she couldn't run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yet that sheer tenacity spurred her sister 
on... And once she was able to run again, 
her true talent blossomed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had heard a little about it from Mejiro 
Ardan before. I wonder how that event 
shaped the Mejiro Ramonu of today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister was having issues with her legs, 
and it seemed the doctors weren't even 
sure if she'd ever be able to race again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She has a delicate constitution... I had a 
frail body as well, so when we were young, 
we used to lie side by side in bed 
together.
choice_data_list: I can't even imagine what lies ahead……
I can't even imagine what lies ahead……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Ane-sama... became the person she 
is today only after making painstaking, 
blood-soaked efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ane-sama's devotion back in those days... 
was truly terrifying. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
One day, she was running alongside the 
others... no, she was sprinting across the 
track faster than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Because I was repeatedly hospitalized and 
discharged, I was unable to see everything 
firsthand. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you overcome adversity and run so 
freely, Elder Sister, gave me hope during 
my days in the hospital.
choice_data_list: So that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, doesn't this person just want to 
know how to talk to Ramonu-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's true. A way to talk...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is quite simple~ You just say, 
"Ramonu-sama~," and... sit right beside 
her~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And so, I shall ask what I wish to know 
most~.
choice_data_list: The thing I want to know most...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is true. It is something found within 
your heart, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after that, it was time to move on, 
so I thanked everyone and left... but 
Mejiro Bright's words remained in my mind.
choice_data_list: (The thing I most want to know, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is so mysterious, and there is so much 
I want to know. And out of all of it, the 
thing I want to know most...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Without finding an answer, the next day 
arrived.
choice_data_list: Ramonu, got a second?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I wonder what it is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The way to talk to Mejiro Ramonu, as 
taught by Mejiro Bright... The time has 
finally come to put it to the test.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's pretty embarrassing, but... I've 
just got to do it!"
choice_data_list: ...L-Lady Ramonu~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: ...Would you like to sit down and talk?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...My hail-mary plan failed, too. I wonder 
if the day will ever come when I can have 
a normal conversation with Mejiro 
Ramonu...
